content.Title: 2024 Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery Guideline
Summary: Emphasis on the economic outcomes of anatomical versus functional diagnostic testing for coronary artery disease.
Comparison of exercise echocardiography to exercise electrocardiography for clinical and economic impacts.
Evaluation of facility-level associations of preoperative stress testing with postoperative adverse cardiac events.
Identification of patients with stable chest pain and low value from noninvasive testing.
References: Douglas PS, Hoffmann U, Patel MR, et al.
Mark DB, Douglas PS, Daniels MR.
Zacharias K, Ahmed A, Shah BN, et al.
Valle JA, Graham L, Thiruvoipati T, et al.
Fordyce CB, Douglas PS, Roberts RS, et al.
Nanna MG, Yow E, Vemulapalli S, et al.
